ambiguous_rows.actual_type: clinical response (NCI-WG + flow cytometry) at 3 months
ambiguous_rows.notes: Description says 'combined morphological [NCI-WG criteria] + flow cytometry criteria' without enumerating which response categories (CR/PR/nPR) count as response; flow-cytometry component suggests MRD-flavored composite. Insufficient to confirm strict CR+PR ORR; also a 3-month landmark.

Registry description gives no response criteria at all ('to estimate the clinical response rate ... after immunotherapy'); trial terminated early. Cannot determine whether CR+PR objective response was meant.

false_calls.notes: CR/PR of radiotracer uptake on isotope bone scan per protocol-specific Bone Scan Time Point Response Criteria - imaging-modality-specific, not RECIST-type objective response.
Composite: PSA decline >=50% AND/OR radiographic CR/PR per PCWG3; PSA-only responders count, so not strict ORR.
PSA >=50% decline confirmed >=3 weeks later - biochemical response.
Overall response = CR + PR + marrow CR + hematologic improvement - composite including HI and marrow-only CR, broader than CR+PR.

Clinical response = CR or PR by objective lesion criteria (lesion count/flattening/50% decrease in sum of products of perpendicular diameters) - disease-appropriate objective CR+PR standard (KS-type), analogous to WHO bidimensional criteria.

false_calls.actual_type: CR+PR of premalignant oral lesions (WHO-style bidimensional)
false_calls.notes: CR = disappearance of lesions; PR = >=50% reduction in sum of products of diameters - objective CR+PR by WHO-style measurement, but on premalignant lesions (oral leukoplakia/erythroplakia chemoprevention), not malignant-tumor ORR; flag if pool is restricted to cancer ORR.
OR = CR + PR per RECIST; assessed at 4 months, i.e. objective response rate at that timepoint (allowed per criteria).
Title is vague but description explicitly defines the measure as ORR = CR + PR per RECIST 1.1.
Response = CR + CRp + CRi within 3 months - CR-variant hematologic composite, no PR.
CR/PR restricted to unirradiated lesions using irRECIST - immune-related criteria variant (excluded) and lesion-subset-restricted, not standard ORR.

corpus_weighted_accuracy.note: weights = corpus pool shares at sampling time
